title: Cropland PAtteRNS: Parallel Dimensional Attention Networks and Attention to Dataset Disparity for Crop Segmentation in Satellite Imagery Time Series Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.38165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The landscape of satellite imagery time series datasets and boundary-pushing architectures for cropland segmentation has never been richer. However, in this gold rush, important truths are being missed on both fronts, as a drive for the most novel concepts or the largest datasets pushes finer details to the side. In this paper, we present our hybrid transformer-convolutional model, Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation (PAtteRNS), the first model to use self-attention mechanisms separately for each of the temporal, spectral, and spatial aspects of Sentinel-2 multispectral SITS data. To achieve fully-factorised attention in our proposed model, we introduce a novel parallel transformer architecture which significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention. translated_title: 农田PAtteRNS：并行维度注意力网络与对数据集差异的关注——用于卫星影像时间序列数据的作物分割
translated_abstract: 卫星影像时间序列数据集与用于农田分割的突破性架构从未如此丰富。然而，在这场淘金热中，两个方向上都有重要的事实被忽视，因为对新概念或最大数据集的追逐使更细节的问题被搁置一旁。在本文中，我们提出了混合transformer-卷积模型——用于分割的农田并行注意力与细化网络（PAtteRNS），这是首个对Sentinel-2多光谱卫星影像时间序列（SITS）数据的时间、光谱和空间三个维度分别使用自注意力机制的模型。为了在所提出的模型中实现完全因子化的注意力，我们引入了一种新颖的并行transformer架构，显著降低了三重因子化自注意力的计算复杂度。我们通过深入的消融研究验证了我们的架构，并分析了我们的模型相对于当前最先进的（此处摘要原文被截断）……
tldr: 提出首个对Sentinel-2卫星影像时间序列数据的时间、光谱、空间三个维度分别施加自注意力的混合transformer-卷积农田分割模型PAtteRNS，并借助新颖的并行transformer架构显著降低了三重因子化自注意力的计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: We propose PAtteRNS, the first hybrid transformer-convolutional model to apply self-attention separately to the temporal, spectral, and spatial dimensions of Sentinel-2 satellite image time series for crop segmentation, featuring a novel parallel transformer architecture that significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention.
